auth.register.description: Generate wallet passkey s'sassunagh lesh dty innid. Cha nel feme erbee er crypto.
auth.register.biometricPrompt: Gow dty bhraar son ymmyd biometric
auth.register.securityNote: Ta'n wallet eu ry-gheddyn liorish biometrics eu. Nish cha nel keys privee goll er y ghraih.
auth.sign.title: Cree dty choontey
auth.sign.terms: As t'ou goll er, t'ou goaill rish nyn
auth.login.signInDescription: Cleays do passkey dy gheddyn stiagh er do account dy scanshoil.
auth.login.noPasskey: Cha nel passkey erbee er y ghraih shoh.
auth.login.noAccountFound: Cha nel coontey erbee er ny gheddyn
auth.login.welcomeDescription: Ta shiu er nyn goyrt stiagh nish.
landing.heroDesc: Circlyn sparran dy-mheanagh er Stellar. Zero ny mraane. Sovereigntyn argidoil son y 1.3 billion nagh vel bancagh.
landing.feat1Desc: Ta contractyn smart cur stiagh gagh reiltys. Nish cha vod organizer erbee reih rish y pool. Gagh co-choyrle verify on-chain.
landing.feat2Desc: Jeh dooinney erbee lesh wallet Stellar. Cha nel cuntas bancagh. Cha nel scansh crediit. Gyn cliaghtey.
landing.feat3Desc: Toiggal dty MoiScore lesh gagh co-choyrle on-time. Identity argidoil portagh.
landing.feat4Desc: Ta ymmyd jeh sub-cent stellar jannoo circlyn laa as laa pragmatagh. Cha nel coad platform erbee dy chroo ny dy gholl stiagh.
landing.feat5Desc: Random, s'cadjin, auction, ny vote. Yn circle, ny recortyssyn.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC y laa shoh. Stablecoins er y raad.
landing.readyDesc: Cree yn chiad circle savings ayd ayns fo daa mhinid.
error.generic: Va red erbee er n'gholl er-shaghryn
